strengths: Concrete street scenes and conditional-bin distinctions read like magazine feature writing

issues.problem: Closing stacks explanatory restatement ('When you cannot find a can…' / 'If you remember only one nuance…') with similar cadence, feeling padded rather than decisive.
issues.suggestion: End on one concrete image (pocket/bag/hotel bin as hidden infrastructure) plus one sentence of insight.

issues.problem: 'Understanding the answer means holding two ideas at once' is slightly meta-editorial.
issues.suggestion: State the two factors in one plain sentence without the 'holding ideas' frame.
